inventory.selection_note: Continue after the higher-scored SPEEDZ complete-build pass found no distinct direct source. Select the next highest-scored blocked technical fields on exact published CAMP builds; do not repeat recent direct-page, chart, or JD routes.

scope.research_boundary: One Luna Max evidence-only reviewer; root is sole writer. Review one exact model and one missing field at a time. Seek at most one newly discovered, direct CAMP-manufacturer technical source per field. A single exact-field query may identify one best matching page, which may be opened once. Report exact URL/title, publisher and source class, access date, claim, and caveat. A route counts only if it names the exact GX600 or GX700 frame/build and directly supports that field.
excluded: Do not repeat https://www.campbicycle.com/en/gx600.html, https://www.campbicycle.com/gravel_92368/gx600.html, https://www.campbicycle.com/gravel_92368/gx700.html, the generic size.avif geometry charts (403 on 2026-09-24), https://mall.jd.com/index-12210175.html (timed out on 2026-09-24), or the GX700 JD item inspected on 2026-09-24.
Do not repeat previously exhausted 50-area sweeps or retrieve other-model geometry, clearance, frame-weight, or bottom-bracket data.
No XHS, Weibo, login, CAPTCHA, challenge handling, seller contact, purchase, cart, quote, external message, source write, catalog write, image download, or image rehosting.
Do not infer maximum clearance from the fitted tire, geometry from size options, frame weight from complete-bike weight, or a bottom-bracket standard from crank or axle descriptions.
No source or value is added to the catalog unless it directly establishes the exact model/build and field. Preserve unresolved values with the exact reason.
